scientific_integrity: Explicit geodesic perimeter, positive normalized degree-one and degree-two sampling densities, bounded likelihood transfer, exact second/sixth Haar moments, Dyson Fourier identity, and sharp trace inequality. Numerical verification is ancillary.
scientific_limitations: Leading near-maximal perimeter tail in fixed dimension three for three independent samples; the isotropic scalar constant and conditional Dyson law predate this result. The Le 1989 full text and an unpublished 1994 manuscript could not be inspected. No external mathematical audit.
title: A sharp dipole–quadrupole saddle in extreme spherical-triangle perimeter probabilities
